response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced senior engineer with genuine systems-level chops (low-latency DLang microservices handling millions of requests per second, Kubernetes deployments, strong testing culture), but he falls well short of the core minimum qualifications: his C++ experience is limited to a ~7-month stint at National Instruments and a thesis project versus the required 8 years, and his background is predominantly full-stack web/product work rather than cloud compute platform infrastructure. He also lacks formal technical-leadership experience mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers, making him a poor fit for this specific tech lead role despite his overall seniority.
strengths: Real high-scale, low-latency systems experience (Sociomantic: millions of HTTP requests/sec, async I/O, fibers)
Strong engineering craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, open-source library authorship, and active mentoring via workshops and courses
Broad technical range across backend, infrastructure tooling, Kubernetes, and multiple languages
concerns: Far below the required 8 years of C++ experience; primary systems language is D, not C++
No formal technical leadership role leading platform/cloud teams or owning technical strategy
Career centered on web/product full-stack work rather than cloud compute platforms, storage, or hardware architecture
